stem:
Tania checks the even numbers $6$ and $10$ and asks whether their sum is a multiple of $4$.

Which statement is correct?

options.text: Any sum of two even numbers may be labeled a multiple of $4$.
Every sum of two even numbers is a multiple of $4$, with no further check.
$6$ and $10$ both leave remainder $2$ on division by $4$, so their sum $16$ is a multiple of $4$.
The same remainder rule also applies unchanged when one addend is odd.

teacher.key_rationale: 6 ≡ 2 and 10 ≡ 2 (mod 4), so matching remainders make 16 a multiple of 4. Labeling every even sum as a multiple of 4, skipping the remainder check, or applying the rule to an odd addend miss that condition.
